highlights.label: Statistical thermodynamics
highlights.value: Principles of thermodynamics, statistical physics and numerical simulation.

paragraphs: Temporary Lecturer contract in the Department of Chemistry at King's College London, under the supervision of Micaela MATTA, to teach statistical thermodynamics, including the fundamentals of numerical simulation and molecular dynamics, to third-year chemistry undergraduate students.

My responsibility was to assist Micaela MATTA in creating the course curriculum, from establishing the order of the chapters to defining the objectives to be achieved in each class. I then had to prepare all the teaching materials for the chapters assigned to me (10 out of a total of 12 chapters), together with the corresponding class exercises.

I then taught the course to a class of approximately 90 students, presenting all the chapters planned for the course and correcting the class exercises to demonstrate the methodologies students were expected to apply.
Finally, I contributed to the creation and marking of the exercises and examinations.
